posts.title: Welcome to my corner of the internet
posts.description: Hello World! ✌️ If you’ve found this small corner of the internet, you probably already know me. But in case you do not: Hi, my name is Anita. Nice to meet you! As a senior software engineer with over a decade of experience, I embrace life long learning and enjoy mentoring and teaching.

posts.title: My first steps in public speaking and how you can do it, too
posts.description: I walked into the room where I would give my first conference talk just to get a feel for it. Seeing all those empty chairs, my nerves hit me like a ton of bricks.
